description: This file implements the PovertyLineService interface in a Spring-based Java application. It provides methods to retrieve poverty line data associated with different likelihoods and PPP names from a relational database using JDBC. The class constructs data transfer objects representing poverty lines and likelihoods, and contains private helper methods for executing specific SQL queries.

classes.name: PovertyLineServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class that provides methods to fetch poverty line data related to likelihoods and PPP names from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all poverty line data associated with a specific PPI name, including likelihoods and their corresponding poverty lines.

methods.name: retrieveForLikelihood
methods.description: Retrieves poverty line data for a specific likelihood within a given PPI name.

methods.name: getLikelihoods
methods.description: Executes an SQL query to get all likelihoods and their associated PPI data.

methods.name: getPovertyLines (String ppiName)
methods.description: Executes an SQL query to get poverty line records associated with a specific PPI name.

methods.name: getPovertyLines (Long likelihoodId)
methods.description: Executes an SQL query to get poverty line records associated with a specific likelihood ID.
